repos_data.description: mu (μ): most of what a coding agent decides isn't code. mu hands 40 kinds of yes/no calls to a small model: fewer wasted tokens, fewer approvals on autopilot, fewer runs that stop halfway. Built on pi.
Open-source, local-first social media research agent for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Jev routes read-only steps; socai CLI captures cited browser evidence.
An MCP server that provides comprehensive US legislation.

One hotkey to ask any AI on Mac. Open-source menu bar assistant: press ⌥Space to ask with your own API key (OpenAI, Claude, any OpenAI-compatible), act on selected text, or send it to ChatGPT, Perplexity or a local CLI agent. Native Swift.
Jev-powered search infrastructure for AI agents: zero API keys, MCP-ready, LLM-context aware, with local neural evidence verification.
Judgment calls as one line of Python, built for TypeSafe AI's Jev and running on any small model: likely / classify / rate → YES, NO or UNSURE. Also local NLI, local LLMs, Ollama, vLLM, OpenAI.
MCP server for Jev (TypeSafe System One): the three official question types — choice, score, noul — plus batch classify. Calibrated probabilities, ~0.5s, <$0.001/call.
